value.rationale: A natural rank-two Kneser geodesic convexity class admits a complete all-coefficient VC-shattering theorem and precise exceptional structural descriptions. The nonmonotone n=5-to-6 VC-dimension change is a meaningful invariant boundary, and the n>=7 characterization connects graph convexity to complete-graph matchings.
